headline: Sources: Jaguars LT Anton Harrison to undergo knee surgery
summary: Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison will have arthroscopic surgery on his right knee when the team returns from London next week, league sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

summary: The Cardinals and Texans’ Marvin Harrison Jr. trade is now official. The third-year wide receiver passed his Texans physical Monday and will begin preparing to make his Houston debut. headline: Bills QB Josh Allen earns first overtime win of career vs. Rams on MNF
summary: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his careerlong winless streak in OT.

headline: Jim Harbaugh says he, Chargers ownership 'in this fight together' amid 0-5 start
summary: With the Chargers off to an 0-5 start for the first time since 2003, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that he and the team's ownership group are "shoulder to shoulder where we're in this fight together."

headline: Mike Pettine Coming Out Of Retirement To Join Cowboys’ Staff
summary: Mike Pettine’s winter departure from the Vikings’ staff was classified as retirement. But the veteran staffer later said he was not sure if he would return to coaching. headline: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw Receives One-Game Suspension
summary: After a sideline dustup led to an ejection on Sunday, 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw will sit out Week 6. The NFL has suspended Greenlaw one game without pay for headbutting helmetless Seahawks linebacker Ernest Jones IV in Week 5. Greenlaw will appeal, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
